front_blocks.md: In the following system, would an increase or decrease in pressure favour the forward reaction? **(Extended Tier Only)**
2A + 2B  ⇌ C + D

back_blocks.md: Increasing the pressure would favour the forward reaction.
This is because there are 4 molecules on the left and side and 2 molecules on the right hand side.
An increase in pressure will favour the side with the fewest number of molecules.

front_blocks.md: If the forward reaction is endothermic, would a high or low temperature increase the yield of products? **(Extended Tier Only)**

back_blocks.md: If the forward reaction is endothermic, a high temperature would increase the yield of products.
